LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Writing
Topic 3.1: Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing, part of Writing in Grade 6 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can one ensure clarity when writing texts?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Critical thinking and Problem solving: The learner displays creativity and open mindedness when they use locally available

materials to practise writing the numbers in Chinese.

Values:
Unity: The learner displays team spirit as they play the word relay games on greetings and introduction with peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion is enhanced as the learner respectfully and harmoniously works with peers to make introductions of self and

others.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner links their learning to Creative Arts on the concept of using varied mediums to express themselves artistically.
